verdict.reasons: The candidate correctly displays the white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll (tape20) and includes the required watermark. The core visual identity and product integration are successful with a coherent scene. However, the technical evidence does not accurately match the requested setup; the image depicts the pressure gauge mounted on an inline vertical pipe rather than a 'short normal threaded port of a continuous irrigation header' as described, and the drip tape is shown coiled on the soil instead of connected by a take-off fitting. These deviations in the technical evidence are core mismatches but do not affect the visual acceptability of the product illustration.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP drip irrigation tape package is positioned on the soil with a visible, uninterrupted gap surrounding its complete footprint. The black irrigation line and pressure gauge are located on the opposite side of the field; no line touches, crosses, or emerges from the package. The line on the right is a continuous installed lateral loop and is not an extra loose product. The carton sides and base are clean, with no visible protruding strips, ribbons, or tape tails.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
